name: learn-database-workbook-platform
description: Interactive workbook platform for the Learn Database course.

scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @learn-database/api && npm run build -w @learn-database/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @learn-database/workbook-schema && npm run build -w @learn-database/lti && npm run build -w @learn-database/db
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:health
